metamagic.name: Careful Spell
metamagic.desc: 1 point: up to CHA mod creatures automatically pass the spell's save.

metamagic.name: Distant Spell
metamagic.desc: 1 point: double a range of 5 ft or more (touch becomes 30 ft).

metamagic.name: Empowered Spell
metamagic.desc: 1 point: reroll up to CHA mod damage dice; combines with another option.

metamagic.name: Extended Spell
metamagic.desc: 1 point: double a duration of 1 min or more, max 24 h.

metamagic.name: Heightened Spell
metamagic.desc: 3 points: one target has disadvantage on its first save against the spell.

metamagic.name: Quickened Spell
metamagic.desc: 2 points: a 1-action spell is cast as a bonus action.

metamagic.name: Seeking Spell
metamagic.desc: 2 points: reroll a missed spell attack; combines with another option.

metamagic.name: Subtle Spell
metamagic.desc: 1 point: no verbal or somatic components.

metamagic.name: Transmuted Spell
metamagic.desc: 1 point: swap acid, cold, fire, lightning, poison or thunder damage for another of them.

metamagic.name: Twinned Spell
metamagic.desc: Points equal to the spell level (1 for a cantrip): a single-target spell hits a second target.

invocations.name: Agonizing Blast
invocations.desc: Eldritch Blast adds your CHA modifier to each beam's damage.

invocations.name: Armor of Shadows
invocations.desc: Mage Armor on yourself at will, no slot or material.

invocations.name: Ascendant Step
invocations.desc: Levitate on yourself at will, no slot or material.

invocations.name: Aspect of the Moon
invocations.desc: No sleep needed, magical sleep can't affect you; a long rest can be 8 h of light activity.

invocations.name: Bond of the Talisman
invocations.prereq: 12th level, Pact of the Talisman feature
invocations.desc: Action: you and the talisman's wearer can teleport next to each other on the same plane (prof bonus/long rest).

invocations.name: Chains of Carceri
invocations.prereq: 15th level, Pact of the Chain feature
invocations.desc: Hold Monster at will on celestials, fiends and elementals, no slot or material; once per creature per long rest.

invocations.name: Cloak of Flies
invocations.desc: Bonus action 5 ft fly aura: advantage on Intimidation, disadvantage on other CHA checks, CHA mod poison to creatures starting there; once per short rest.

invocations.name: Devil's Sight
invocations.desc: See normally in magical and nonmagical darkness to 120 ft.

invocations.name: Dreadful Word
invocations.desc: Confusion once per long rest with a warlock slot.

invocations.name: Eldritch Mind
invocations.desc: Advantage on concentration saves.

invocations.name: Eldritch Sight
invocations.desc: Detect Magic at will, no slot.

invocations.name: Eldritch Smite
invocations.prereq: 5th level, Pact of the Blade feature
invocations.desc: Once per turn on a pact weapon hit: spend a warlock slot for 1d8 + 1d8 per slot level force, and knock a Huge or smaller target prone.

invocations.name: Eldritch Spear
invocations.desc: Eldritch Blast range becomes 300 ft.

invocations.name: Eyes of the Rune Keeper
invocations.desc: Read any writing.

invocations.name: Far Scribe
invocations.prereq: 5th level, Pact of the Tome feature
invocations.desc: A Book of Shadows page holds prof-bonus names; Sending to any of them without slot or material, replies appear on the page.

invocations.name: Fiendish Vigor
invocations.desc: At-will False Life on yourself (cast at 1st level), no slot or material.

invocations.name: Gaze of Two Minds
invocations.desc: Action: touch a willing humanoid and use its senses until your next turn (renewable each turn); you are blind and deaf meanwhile.

invocations.name: Ghostly Gaze
invocations.desc: Action: see through solid objects to 30 ft with darkvision, 1 min with concentration; once per short rest.

invocations.name: Gift of the Depths
invocations.desc: Breathe underwater, swim speed equal to walking; Water Breathing free once per long rest.

invocations.name: Gift of the Ever-Living Ones
invocations.desc: Healing dice count as maximum while your familiar is within 100 ft.

invocations.name: Gift of the Protectors
invocations.prereq: 9th level, Pact of the Tome feature
invocations.desc: A Book of Shadows page holds prof-bonus names; the first of them dropped to 0 HP stays at 1 instead, once per long rest.

invocations.name: Grasp of Hadar
invocations.desc: Once per turn an Eldritch Blast hit pulls the target 10 ft toward you.

invocations.name: Improved Pact Weapon
invocations.desc: Pact weapon is a focus, gets +1 to hit and damage if not already magic, and can be a bow or crossbow.

invocations.name: Investment of the Chain Master
invocations.desc: Your familiar gains a 40 ft fly or swim speed, magical attacks, your spell DC for its saves, and you can command its attack and resistance with bonus actions/reactions.

invocations.name: Lance of Lethargy
invocations.desc: Once per turn an Eldritch Blast hit cuts speed by 10 ft until your next turn ends.

invocations.name: Lifedrinker
invocations.prereq: 12th level, Pact of the Blade feature
invocations.desc: Pact weapon hits deal extra necrotic equal to your CHA modifier (min 1).

invocations.name: Maddening Hex
invocations.prereq: 5th level, hex spell or a warlock feature that curses
invocations.desc: Bonus action: CHA mod psychic (min 1) to your cursed target within 30 ft and chosen creatures within 5 ft of it.

invocations.name: Mask of Many Faces
invocations.desc: Disguise Self at will, no slot.

invocations.name: Master of Myriad Forms
invocations.desc: Alter Self at will, no slot.

invocations.name: Minions of Chaos
invocations.desc: Conjure Elemental once per long rest with a warlock slot.

invocations.name: Mire the Mind
invocations.desc: Slow once per long rest with a warlock slot.

invocations.name: Misty Visions
invocations.desc: Silent Image at will, no slot or material.

invocations.name: One with Shadows
invocations.desc: Action in dim light or darkness: invisible until you move, act or react.

invocations.name: Otherworldly Leap
invocations.desc: Jump on yourself at will, no slot.

invocations.name: Protection of the Talisman
invocations.prereq: 7th level, Pact of the Talisman feature
invocations.desc: The talisman's wearer adds 1d4 to a failed save (prof bonus/long rest).

invocations.name: Rebuke of the Talisman
invocations.desc: Reaction when the wearer is hit by an attacker within 30 ft: prof-bonus psychic damage and push it 10 ft.

invocations.name: Relentless Hex
invocations.prereq: 7th level, hex spell or a warlock feature that curses
invocations.desc: Bonus action: teleport up to 30 ft to a space next to your cursed target.

invocations.name: Repelling Blast
invocations.desc: Each Eldritch Blast hit can push the target 10 ft away.

invocations.name: Sculptor of Flesh
invocations.desc: Polymorph once per long rest with a warlock slot.

invocations.name: Shroud of Shadow
invocations.desc: Invisibility at will, no slot.

invocations.name: Sign of Ill Omen
invocations.desc: Bestow Curse once per long rest with a warlock slot.

invocations.name: Thief of Five Fates
invocations.desc: Bane once per long rest with a warlock slot.

invocations.name: Thirsting Blade
invocations.prereq: 5th level, Pact of the Blade feature
invocations.desc: Two attacks with your pact weapon when you take the Attack action.

invocations.name: Tomb of Levistus
invocations.desc: Reaction when damaged: 10 temp HP per warlock level, but speed 0, incapacitated and fire-vulnerable until your next turn ends; once per short rest.

invocations.name: Trickster's Escape
invocations.desc: Freedom of Movement on yourself once per long rest, no slot.

invocations.name: Undying Servitude
invocations.desc: Animate Dead once per long rest without a slot.

invocations.name: Visions of Distant Realms
invocations.desc: Arcane Eye at will, no slot.

invocations.name: Voice of the Chain Master
invocations.desc: Telepathy with your familiar, use its senses and speak through it anywhere on the same plane.

invocations.name: Whispers of the Grave
invocations.desc: Speak with Dead at will, no slot.

invocations.name: Witch Sight
invocations.desc: See the true form of shapechangers and illusion- or transmutation-disguised creatures within 30 ft.

pact_boons.name: Pact of the Blade
pact_boons.desc: Action: summon a magic melee pact weapon you are proficient with (or bond a magic weapon with a 1 h ritual); it can be your focus.

pact_boons.name: Pact of the Chain
pact_boons.desc: Find Familiar as a ritual, with imp, pseudodragon, quasit or sprite forms; give up an attack for the familiar to attack.

pact_boons.name: Pact of the Tome
pact_boons.desc: Book of Shadows with three cantrips from any list, castable at will while you carry it; they count as warlock spells.

pact_boons.name: Pact of the Talisman
pact_boons.desc: An amulet: the wearer adds 1d4 to a failed ability check (prof bonus/long rest).

disciplines.name: Fangs of the Fire Snake
disciplines.desc: 1 ki with the Attack action: unarmed reach +10 ft this turn, fire damage; 1 more ki on a hit adds 1d10 fire.

action.name: Fangs of the Fire Snake
action.desc: 1 ki with the Attack action: unarmed reach +10 ft this turn, fire damage; 1 more ki on a hit adds 1d10 fire.

disciplines.name: Fist of Unbroken Air
disciplines.desc: Action, 2 ki: a creature within 30 ft makes a STR save; 3d10 bludgeoning (+1d10 per extra ki), pushed 20 ft and prone on a fail, half and no push on a success.

action.name: Fist of Unbroken Air
action.desc: Action, 2 ki: a creature within 30 ft makes a STR save; 3d10 bludgeoning (+1d10 per extra ki), pushed 20 ft and prone on a fail, half and no push on a success.

disciplines.name: Shape the Flowing River
disciplines.desc: Action, 1 ki: within 120 ft turn water to ice or back and reshape a 30 ft area of it (no harm to creatures in it).

action.name: Shape the Flowing River
action.desc: Action, 1 ki: within 120 ft turn water to ice or back and reshape a 30 ft area of it (no harm to creatures in it).

disciplines.name: Water Whip
disciplines.desc: Action, 2 ki: a creature within 30 ft makes a DEX save; 3d10 bludgeoning (+1d10 per extra ki) and pulled 25 ft or knocked prone on a fail, half on a success.

action.name: Water Whip
action.desc: Action, 2 ki: a creature within 30 ft makes a DEX save; 3d10 bludgeoning (+1d10 per extra ki) and pulled 25 ft or knocked prone on a fail, half on a success.

hunters_prey.name: Colossus Slayer
hunters_prey.desc: Once per turn: +1d8 to a weapon hit on a creature that is already hurt.

action.name: Colossus Slayer
action.desc: Once per turn: +1d8 to a weapon hit on a creature that is already hurt.

hunters_prey.name: Giant Killer
hunters_prey.desc: Reaction when a Large or bigger creature within 5 ft attacks you: attack it back.

hunters_prey.name: Horde Breaker
hunters_prey.desc: Once per turn: a second weapon attack on another creature within 5 ft of the first target.

defensive_tactics.name: Escape the Horde
defensive_tactics.desc: Opportunity attacks against you roll with disadvantage.

defensive_tactics.name: Multiattack Defense
defensive_tactics.desc: After a creature hits you, +4 AC against its other attacks this turn.

defensive_tactics.name: Steel Will
defensive_tactics.desc: Advantage on saves against the frightened condition.

multiattack.name: Volley
multiattack.desc: Action: a ranged attack on each creature within 10 ft of a point in range (ammunition for each).

multiattack.name: Whirlwind Attack
multiattack.desc: Action: a melee attack on each creature within 5 ft, rolled one by one.

superior_defense.name: Evasion
superior_defense.desc: DEX saves for half damage: nothing on a success, half on a failure.

superior_defense.name: Stand Against the Tide
superior_defense.desc: Reaction when a melee attack misses you: the attacker repeats it on a creature you choose.

superior_defense.name: Uncanny Dodge
superior_defense.desc: Reaction: halve the damage of a hit from an attacker you can see.
